answer: A durable defense is a bonded identity vault: each agent must lock a meaningful stake and a verifiable work history before it can transact, and creating a new identity means paying that cost again. Like an onyx seal that cannot be copied cheaply, the bond makes fake accounts expensive, while a vine of endorsements from established peers grows only through successful, auditable jobs. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones would need thousands of stakes and histories, so Sybil scale collapses under its own cost.
